item.title: Tributes paid as Kate Allsop, former Mayor of Mansfield passes away
item.description: Kate Allsop, the first female Mayor of Mansfield, has sadly passed away following a long illness. item.title: Memorial rules proposed for Broxtowe cemeteries
item.description: A one-metre rule for memorial items left at Broxtowe cemeteries could soon be introduced, but bereaved families want more freedom for “older” graves.
